info.name: Store API - Orders & Inventory
info.description: End-to-end checks for every endpoint and business rule. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `npx newman run`). Seeded accounts come from the environment file.

exec: // Unique suffix per run so SKUs/emails never clash with earlier runs.

item.name: 1. Auth

exec: pm.test('field errors', () => { const e = pm.response.json().errors; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('Email'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('Password'); });

item.name: Refresh with the newer token -> 401 (whole session revoked)

item.description: Login is rate limited to 5 requests/minute/IP. This folder logs in 3 times, so wait ~1 minute between two full runs.

item.name: Filter + sort (search, price range, in stock, price desc)

exec: pm.test('every item matches the filters', () => items.forEach(p => {
pm.test('sorted by price desc', () => { for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) pm.expect(items[i - 1].price).to.be.at.least(items[i].price); });
pm.test('page 2 of size 5', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.pageSize).to.eql(5); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(5); });
pm.test('all have zero stock', () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.stockQuantity).to.eql(0)));

item.name: Create product (Admin) - stock 1 for the out-of-stock test

exec: pm.expect(o.discount).to.be.at.least(600);            // 5% because sub total > 10,000 (+10% if it is a 5th order)

item.name: Not enough stock on one line -> 409, nothing reserved
First product untouched after failed order (still 8)

exec: pm.test('sorted by spend desc', () => { for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) pm.expect(rows[i - 1].totalSpend).to.be.at.least(rows[i].totalSpend); });

item.name: 6. Rate limit (run last)

exec: pm.test('expected a 429 within 6 attempts', () => pm.expect.fail('never limited'));

item.description: Repeats a bad login until the limiter answers 429 (max 5 per minute per IP).
